{{recipesummary|Soup recipes|4|1 hour|2}}
{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of the United States|American cuisine]] | [[Cookbook:Vegetarian cuisine|Vegetarian Cuisine]] | [[Cookbook:Soups|Soups]]

==Ingredients==

* 1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoon]] [[Cookbook:Olive Oil|olive oil]]
* ½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Dice|diced]] [[Cookbook:Onion|onion]]
* 1 can (14 ounces) diced [[Cookbook:Tomato|tomatoes]]
* 1½ cups [[Cookbook:Chicken|chicken]] or vegetable [[Cookbook:Broth|broth]]
* 1 can (16 ounces) [[Cookbook:Tomato Sauce|tomato sauce]]
* 1 tablespoon fresh snipped [[Cookbook:Basil|basil]] (or 1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]] dried)
* 1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]] fresh snipped [[Cookbook:Thyme|thyme]] (or ¼ teaspoon dried)
* 1 dash [[Cookbook:Pepper|pepper]]
* 2 tablespoons [[Cookbook:Vinegar|balsamic vinegar]] (optional)
* 4–6 fresh [[Cookbook:Basil|basil]] leaves (optional), [[Cookbook:Slicing|sliced]] thinly into strips

==Procedure==

# In a 2-[[Cookbook:Quart|quart]] [[Cookbook:Saucepan|saucepan]], [[Cookbook:Sautéing|sauté]] onion in olive oil until tender but not browned.
# Add tomatoes, broth, tomato sauce, basil, thyme and pepper.
# Bring to a [[Cookbook:Boiling|boil]].
# Reduce heat, cover and [[Cookbook:Simmering|simmer]] 20 minutes.
# Stir in vinegar, if desired, just prior to serving.
# Ladle into bowls and [[Cookbook:Garnish|garnish]] with basil strips.
